transit_words.description: Engineering Services for the Detailed Measurement and Structural Assessment of Railway Bridges (Package A): To conduct a detailed inspection of the Metrolinx-owned railway bridge at 3575 Danforth Avenue, the bridge spans, piers, and abutments will be inspected. Ultrasonic Thickness measurements will be collected on Girder and Flange beams, hand tools will be used to clean inspection areas. Flashlights, and measuring tapes will be used. A scissor lift will be used to access the underside of the bridge. During the inspection, one lane will be closed at a time until the full length of the bridge has been inspected. Each lane closure is expected to last approximately 1 to 1.5 hours.
